_doc.about: wall: a living wall of looping tiles; the camera dives into hero tiles (the «حلوة يا بلدي» look, 2026-11-08).
_doc.tiles: the wall, 3 per row, left to right then down: each a clip (src, ss, focus, box, zoom, speed); each loops `loop` seconds at 360x640 / 15 fps; 24 tiles = 8 rows fill the final pull-back
_doc.heroes: tiles the camera dives into: tile = index in tiles, start = when the dive begins (the first hero starts at 0: the film opens inside it), end = end of the hold; the dive takes 2.2 s, so give each hero 2.4 s or more; ss overrides the tile's in-point for the full-size frames
_doc.title: drawn as the first line, in gold Ruqaa 120 (no separate title slot on the wall)
_doc.lines: words at y 1640, Tajawal 66, word by word
_doc.end: the camera pulls back on the whole wall 2.6 s after the last hero; the end card dims it; credit 1.4 s later
_doc.cols / loop: columns of the wall (3) and the tile loop length in seconds (2.9)
